text:
kai: quick heads-up — I'm drafting the internal announce for the 2026.03.1 deploy. Need a decision on model pinning and the short rollback blurb. Planning to publish the internal note ~1 hour before the window.
sasha: change window still Friday 02:00 UTC? that's the low-traffic slot for EU/NA right? :calendar:
release-captain: yes friday 02:00 UTC, 3h change window, canary -> ramp. Deploy plan is in the doc: https://go.redwood/internal/releases/2026-03-1 (working copy).
marta: on pinning: recommend pin to model v2.3-quant for hosted and dedicated for the first 24h. The v2.4 pieces are still flaky on long sequences in canary tests.
kai: +1 to pin v2.3-quant. We'll note in the announce that teams should expect the model to be pinned and the reason (latency regressions on v2.4).
devon: for rollback copy: keep it simple. "If any critical regressions are observed, rollback to previous pinned variant and open an incident." Who owns the rollback?
release-captain: eng-oncall to own first response, infra to execute rollback steps in the playbook. I'll add explicit contact list in the note.
 kai: draft of the internal blurb (copy suggestion):
 ```
 Heads up: We're deploying 2026.03.1 on Fri 02:00 UTC.
 - Pinning model: v2.3-quant for 24h (reduces latency risk).
 - Rollback: eng-oncall -> infra rollback to previous pinned variant. 30m observation window after each ramp.
 - Impact: short 10-30s spikes possible during canary, no expected data path changes.
 Please report issues in #incidents with tag `2026-03-1`.
 ```
sasha: looks good, maybe add a one-liner for support: where to find repro prompts + alert thresholds.
marta: add the trace id pattern and the metric names: `inference.latency.p95` and `errors.rate`. Threshold: p95 > 1.2x baseline or errors.rate > 0.5% triggers rollback consideration.
kai: updated the draft in doc and added metric thresholds. Can folks skim and LGTM so I can send the internal announce 1h before window? :eyes:
release-captain: LGTM from me. I'll also ping sales and CSM once the announce goes out. :shipit:
devon: LGTM. I'll be on standby during the window and will post playbook steps if we need to abort.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created by @release-captain • 2026-03-27 02:00 UTC • canary 5% -> 50% -> 100% • rollback window 30m • runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/deploy-rollback
kai: thanks all — I'll send the internal note at 01:00 UTC and post the short public-facing release blurb after the deploy completes if all good.
sasha: tiny nit — add a line that dedicated customers with pinned capacity will not be auto-upgraded without explicit notice. avoids surprises.
kai: good call, added it. sending in 15m. :thumbsup:
